jangpm.label: Jangpm Lecture Deck
jangpm.summary: Korean-first lecture/report deck with monochrome + single #4633E3 indigo accent. Pretendard typography, 8px grid, Lucide line-art icons. Every content slide ends with a `.gm` governing message line.
jangpm.tone: Editorial, minimal, report-style, restrained. Notion/Linear/Vercel sensibility adapted to Korean instructional content.
jangpm.themeMode: Light only — warm off-white `#FAFAF9` background, `#1A1A1A` text, `#4633E3` single accent.

insightlearning.label: Insightlearning Proposal Deck
insightlearning.summary: Korean B2B HRD proposal / company-profile deck extracted from the 2026 Insightlearning company profile. White content pages with a single deep-navy #012281 accent, section label + split navy rule + centered headline, filled #F8F8F8 cards, navy label-column tables, chevron step bands. Navy narrative bands with sky #58CCFF on cover / chapter / closing.
insightlearning.tone: Confident, consultative, performance-oriented corporate voice (formal 합니다체).
insightlearning.themeMode: Light content (#FFFFFF bg, #1A1A1A text, #012281 accent); navy band on narrative shells only.
